title: Graceful hosted API stall-breaker and staggered retry advisory
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple enterprise customers reported sustained 5xx waves and long tail timeouts during scheduled spike events. Investigation shows a confluence of factors: client SDKs doing aggressive synchronous retries (no jitter), edge connection pool saturation, and a slow KV-cache compaction run that stalled some inference workers. This ticket implements a targeted hotfix and a medium-term set of changes: 1) deploy a stall-breaker admission control on the edge that rejects/fast-fails non-idempotent requests once per-tenant queue depth exceeds a threshold; 2) add an inbound-staggered-retry advisory to customer-facing SDKs + docs with recommended jitter and backoff defaults; 3) schedule KV-cache compaction with low-priority windows and add compaction telemetry to avoid worker stalls; 4) introduce a tenant-scoped emergency throttler and a safer default circuit-breaker profile for hosted endpoints. Goals: stop ongoing 5xx waves, restore tail-latency SLOs, and prevent retry amplification during future tenant surges.
